# fAIble Labs

> fAIble Labs Inc. (Leesburg, Virginia, USA) builds AI-assisted RF signal-analysis software that runs entirely on the customer's own hardware, for defense, test-range, satellite and security environments where recordings cannot leave. Nothing leaves the customer's environment; every check has three answers (yes / no / could not look); AI flags and people decide; content is never decoded.

## What the product does
A recording is placed on an analysis box and moves through five steps: intake, triage, characterize, attribute (link pulses, hops and carriers to the radio that sent them), adjudicate (an engineer accepts, corrects or marks each result unsure).

## What is sold
A base workbench plus licensed modules: RF Analysis; RF Baseline and Change; Satellite Transponder Survey; Drone-Link Class. Delivered on an analysis box supplied at cost, to a published specification, or on the customer's hardware. Yearly licence per box (keeps working if it lapses) or perpetual; security fixes free; no phone-home. Prices on request.
